- Clicking legend item → only grays out the line, keeps legend item visible

4. **Cleaner sync**: Two-way sync between checkboxes and legend selection state

- Checkboxes control legend `selected` state (not whether series exists)
- Listen to ECharts `legendselectchanged` event to update checkboxes
- Both checkbox and legend show the same visual state (checked/selected vs unchecked/grayed)

## ✅ Implementation Complete

### **Changes Made:**

3. **Added legend event listener** (lines ~364-373):
   - Listens to `legendselectchanged` events from ECharts
   - When a legend item is clicked, it updates the corresponding checkbox
   - Removes old listeners to prevent duplicates

### **Expected Behavior:**
- ✅ **Checkbox unchecked**: Line grays out in chart, legend item grays out, but remains visible
- ✅ **Legend item clicked**: Line grays out, corresponding checkbox unchecks  
- ✅ **Both controls stay in sync**: Either control updates the other automatically
- ✅ **All sensors always visible**: Users can see what data is available

The implementation maintains the existing checkbox functionality while adding two-way synchronization with the chart legend. Users can now control series visibility from either the checkboxes at the top or by clicking legend items directly on the chart.
